mistake_reason: At step 17, the Orchestrator demanded absolute consistency and repeatedly instructed WebSurfer to re-execute the same Google Maps walking-direction query (Adrenalinpark Köln → Le Mans Karting) even after receiving stable, correct outputs (6–7 minutes). This unnecessary step repetition (FM-1.3) caused the team to ignore validated results and continue looping. The repetition propagated a verification spiral, eventually leading to confusion and the later conflation of driving time with walking time for a different pair (Paintball Fun → Kartcenter), culminating in a wrong final answer and failure to report the correct venue (Adrenalinpark Köln).
